scope: Initial three completed S1 runs only; this is not an exhaustive narrative audit.
reviewer: survey_audit agent, read-only cross-check against the frozen scenarios

findings.finding: Assumption references were relatively complete in the inspected response. The missed-question or delayed-response story was added by the model, not fixed by S1.
Concern about missing a question and finding catch-up not difficult were labelled scenario_inference. These are permissible generated interpretations, not facts stated in S1.

Some references incompletely support the invented detail: NEW_Q6 specifies 2–3 occurrences but A1 describes overall meeting frequency/conflicts; NEW_Q4 adds pre-meeting agenda scanning and post-meeting to-do checking but only cites A3 about checking chat; NEW_Q13 adds assignment-progress/results without a matching outcome assumption. Structural validation does not establish complete narrative attribution.

shared_warning: All three initial S1 responses added a missed-question or delay episode. Agreement on this invented detail cannot be reported as an observed user pain point.
use: Read alongside machine validation. Retain uncertainty; turn candidate needs into questions for real participants rather than demand estimates.
filename_note: Legacy filename contains manual; actual review was an AI-agent content spot-check, not human review.
